profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Color
profile.summary:
I have a crush on technology. It started when I was in high school and has grown every year. I remember my first interaction with a computer and the first time I surfed the internet, and I was hooked. The thing that hooked me was trying to understand how and why it worked the way it did. And that’s why I’m in school right now majoring in Computer Science.

I moved to the USA in March 2019 for family and professional reasons. I knew that if I wanted to really develop my understanding of technology and pursue my crush, it needed to be done in the US. The process behind the creation of a website or an application continue to fascinate me and drive me towards the completion of my degree.

Outside of work, I enjoy playing games, spending time outside hiking and camping, and going to the movies.
